model.name: Folder owns its children through a per-type parent-children interface (ONE canonical derivation, tree+detail same instance)
model.description: Tron root lens 2026-09-05 (via PO): what belongs to the object lives ON the object, data AND behaviour. Children are answered BY the object through a per-type parent-children interface (node.children()). Folder.children() is the SINGLE owner of its answer; BOTH the tree and the detail render from node.children() on the SAME instance; NO surface derives children by any other means. The measured defect this fixes: the tree and the detail each derived children THEIR OWN WAY = a duplicate derivation = the exact duplication the traceability graph exists to make impossible/visible. This is the fix for the defect Tron can SEE (his folder is still invisible) and everything else waits behind it. Same law as R40.81 one-physical-store: data (store) and behaviour (children) both belong ON the object.

model.crossRefNote: Fixes the duplicate-derivation behind R37.21 P2 client-subscribe (tree vs detail each deriving children own way); once Folder.children() is the single owner + tree/detail render from one instance, the live-insert propagates to both BY CONSTRUCTION (subsumes the narrow-B wiring path). Same DRY law as R40.81 (data-on-object) — this is behaviour-on-object. Rides R40.54 failable-AC family.

acceptanceCriteria.text: EVERY node type implements the per-type parent-children interface (node.children()). A type that can contain children but derives them off-interface => RED. This is the OOP shape: children are answered BY the object, per type.

gateRef.assertion: every ior:class that can have children implements children(); an off-interface child-derivation => RED

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: PENDING: seed a type that derives children without implementing the interface -> RED

acceptanceCriteria.text: Folder.children() is the SINGLE owner of its answer — the canonical derivation of a Folder's children lives ON the Folder, exactly once. A SECOND derivation of a Folder's children anywhere in the codebase => RED (the duplication the traceability graph exists to stop; per the root lens, a 2nd derivation is a TRACEABILITY DEFECT not paperwork).

gateRef.assertion: exactly ONE Folder.children() derivation; a 2nd code path computing a Folder's children => RED

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: PENDING: seed a 2nd Folder-children derivation -> RED

acceptanceCriteria.text: BOTH the tree AND the detail render from node.children() on the SAME instance — one derivation, not two parallel ones (the measured duplicate-derivation bug: tree and detail each deriving children their own way). Screenshot-checkable @390: the children shown in the tree == the children shown in the detail, sourced from ONE node.children() call on ONE node instance. Divergence => RED.

gateRef.assertion: tree children and detail children resolve from one node.children() on one instance; any divergence => RED

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: PENDING @390: seed tree and detail deriving children by different paths -> divergent render -> RED

acceptanceCriteria.text: THE failable guard (a TRACEABILITY QUERY, per the root lens = the system USED as DRY enforcement, not a ledger): NO surface derives children by ANY means other than node.children(). A surface that walks/queries/computes children off-interface => RED. This is the by-construction guarantee that one-derivation cannot be bypassed. ★ AUTOMATIC-FAIL RULING (Tron 2026-09-05): the per-site test is NOT did-the-raw-fetch-disappear but DOES THIS SURFACE ASK AN OBJECT FOR ITS OWN CHILDREN (node.children()). Routing surfaces through a SHARED FETCH/CHILDREN HELPER (import a function, pass it a ref) is a DEFECT BY DEFINITION (a functional construct owning what the object should own = a 2nd place the truth lives) and is an AUTOMATIC FAIL even if the raw-fetch guard goes GREEN. The helper-escape does NOT satisfy this AC.

gateRef.assertion: the gate must test ASKS-OBJECT-FOR-OWN-CHILDREN (node.children()), NOT raw-fetch-gone; a shared children/fetch helper taking a ref => RED even if 0 raw /api/trace/children fetches remain (shared-helper escape closed)

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: PROVEN RED: 9 non-owner sites on current divergence (guard 9ef91a551); GREEN at 0 = the DoD. Registered RED observation (R40.54 stubMustFail SATISFIED) — this AC is now a PROVEN-failable gate, not a wish.
